page.notes: Two columns, read left then right. Entries "Arca cur gloriæ Rex" and the first left-column line "pro animali ibid." carry their numbers at the line end. The large B is a section letter. Greek entry "Ἀνθρωποπάθεια" transcribed as printed; the letters are partly worn and may be imperfect. Words such as "prædicitum", "Asinis" and "Augusti nomē" are as printed; "[?]" not applied because the print is legible enough.
